main.description: One invite naming the requesting athlete that they haven't accepted, with what it lets them copy (feed/activity-invites): the activity's core fields and charts and its startTime, map and speed fields and charts, from every tier whatever the athlete may otherwise see. Never a full track. NotFound for anyone but the invitee, and once the invite lapsed, was cancelled or was accepted. Requires auth.

channels.description: The core and speed channels in data. Absent when the activity has no streams.
